purpose: The Card Token Vault tokenizes primary account numbers to protect them from exposure, allowing payment services to securely store and retrieve card numbers.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: tokenization-service is a stateless service that implements tokenize and detokenize.

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: vault-db (PostgreSQL) holds the encrypted card data and the mapping between tokens and card numbers.

components.name: Vault and KMS
components.evidence: Vault and KMS provide the data encryption keys.

components.name: vault private subnet
components.evidence: vault private subnet is the network segment that contains all of the above.

flows.evidence: tokenization-service asks Vault and KMS for a data encryption key when it starts and again when a key must be replaced.
